nom: Clinique Blackhead Solutions Self-Heating Blackhead Extractor with Salicylic Acid

avis.titre: Easy to use  leaves your skin, soft ￼
avis.texte: I've been using this spot for a long time and it helps me a lot
Must be consistent! When i used this multiple times a week it worked! I started to forget and my blackheads came back.

avis.titre: Saw small difference, nothing drastic though :/
avis.texte: I've been using this product for around a month now and I must say it is a very cool and easy to use product. It feels like a warm wash cloth on your nose when using the rubber applicator. However, I haven't noticed a drastic difference. My pores on my nose may have gotten a little smaller but definitely not gone at all. It does make my nose feel super clean and fresh after use. Wasn't the best for me but could be for you!
It's like a hot wash cloth on your face. And the massaging cap feels good. On my second tube.

couldn't figure it out. maybe i'm stupid but the instructions say to put the product on your face and wet it to activate, but wetting your face washes off the product. really wanted to like it but it's just so frustrating to use :(
The product worked in some areas but not in others. I will give it a little more time on the stubborn areas. It's gentle but don't over do.
I have to say I didn't believe that this product would work the way it is. It's definitely worth the money. You must get it is so worth it…

I have tried this product about three times. Each time, The area being treated becomes very red and irritated with a terrible burning sensation. It appears to be a chemical burn from the use of this product.
My Clinique Consultant, Jordan, explained clearly how to use. He's always so helpful and patient with me. He's the reason I've tried so many new things!!

avis.titre: Gave me cystic acne; feels like exfoliating with sand.
avis.texte: So I have sensitive combination skin, I'm in my early 20s, and I tend to get breakouts when I'm stressed. Because of this, my nose and chin look like the surface of the moon. I began using the Clinique foaming acne cleanser, the 7 day blackhead scrub, their alcohol free toner, the ID hydrating gel for imperfections, and the dramatically different moisturizer. My skin was doing great! I added this bad boy in because a friend recommended it. Unfortunately, all this seemed to do was break me out… REALLY BAD. Normally I just have issues with blackheads, but this gave me those super deep, super painful cystic pimples. When I put it on my face, it feels like I'm rubbing hot magical sand into my skin. The applicator tip is really hard to use and it yellowed very quickly despite my best efforts to clean it (I'm a clean freak). I'm not sure what the deal is, but this seemed add new problems, not erase them.

avis.titre: I've already purchased my second one!
avis.texte: It makes the appearance so much better on your face. The holes in your face seem to close, especially on your chin. Your makeup looks better.

This is the first formula that has ever work to reduce and minimize the blackheads around my nose. My pores on & around my nose are smaller ( I believe) due to the reduction in blackheads. I absolutely love this product and will continue to re-purchase, although it may be a bit pricey. For me,it is worth every penny!!
I count to 30 for my chin and then count 30 for my forehead and 30 for my nose. Rinse and go to bed.
I used it exactly as directed and it did nothing but scrub the surface and make it feel smoother, but as far as extracting the black heads, it did not.
Took Blackheads in 3 uses Use with you're 7 day Pore cleanse and Scrub
Very disappointing! Don't wait your money on this product. I'm sorry I fell for the hype.
I saw results immediately after first use. please learn how to use it before saying ot dosent work
I tried this product and it does nothing to your pores and doesn't clear your black heads all you feel is the product warming up and it's basically a face scrub

Allergy season and tissues caused dry skin around my nose, chin and upper lip, which became a vicious cycle of applying moisturizer, breakouts, and then Dryness (from trying to treat the blackheads). After first use my skin felt hydrated and smooth. The black heads and dry skin were gone. A must have for my skincare regimen.

I was so excited to try a treatment for blackheads. When I tried using this treatment for at least two weeks on my nose and chin my skin begin darkening and blackheads got worse. For the price and outcome it was not worth it. Although, I love Clinique Liquid Face cleanser, moisturizer and clarifying lotion, this treatment did not work for me. I started using peroxide on my blackheads and it has suppress the issue.

I've tried tons of things to get rid of my blackheads. I used this for six weeks and followed the instructions exactly right and nothing has improved to be honest I have even more I didn't even heat up it's a waste of money

avis.titre: Another blackhead targeting product that doesn't work
avis.texte: I've been using this product for a few months now and have noticed no decrease in blackheads. I follow directions to the T, and used it frequently. While it does make my skin softer there has been no noticeable depreciation in blackheads. It is quite expensive for the amount you are getting also, so, overall not a wise investment.
Absolutely love this product very easy to use does the job. I am going to buy the scrub to go along with it.

This stuff is magic! It works so well. I use it on my nose and chin. I have oily acne prone skin & I wear glasses. The pores around my nose are always filled with blackheads and clogged pores. This stuff really works! Only reason I'm giving it a 4 star instead of 5 is the price. While you only need a little bit, it is expensive for the amount of product you're getting.
This is exactly what I was looking for. I was very sensitive skin and this is effective and gentle at the same time. Will definitely buy again!

This product is such garbage. I applied it to problem spots (nose and chin), patted with water, then started to massage my skin with the awkward tool once I felt the heating sensation; however, the heat was brief. In the end, my face broke out and my blackheads are still around. My pores didn't shrink either.
I think the formula was too strong for my skin. It peel off my skin... And the worst thing is that it didnt do anything.
I haven't used it long enough yet to see the results. However I trust Clinique
I have stubborn blackheads on my nose. Used this for about a month and saw no improvement. The little nose massage felt kinda nice though.
I have gotten compliments on my skin since using this product. I notice there are less blackheads where I use it on my face and that makes my pores less noticeable. I will absolutely buy again.
Doesn't work, dedicated a lot of time probably about 7 weeks to it and my skin still looks the same.
This is super expensive to not do anything. You literally have to use a lot of product for you to feel the heat and it is a very small tube. I did not see me blackheads go away.

I was so excited for this product as I am a huge fan of Clinique's clarifying lotion. However, this was really disappointing especially because it's so expensive. It only heats up for about five seconds. The cap is aggressive and I felt like I was damaging my skin every time I used it. No improvement in blackheads.

I used this product until it was gone and did not see any results. I typically used it on my nose as that's where my blackheads are. It did get "warm" to activate my pores, but after that it didn't do much. I think pore strips or a blackhead extractor work much better.

I was very excited to order this product, only to be disappointed. I used this for a month before writing this review. It does not give a heat sensation. Yes, I watched videos and applied it different ways. It was a fail each time. I did not notice a difference in my blackheads around my nose. Annoyed is an understatement and it is over priced. I do not recommend. Note: I love Clinique. I use their makeup daily. Disappointed in this product.

avis.titre: Noticed a difference after first use.
avis.texte: After the first use I noticed a difference in my pores and blackheads. I have since used this a couple more times and I am very happy with it. No reddness or drying of the skin where I've used it.

This product is AMAZING!!! I use it 3x per week before showering and it definitely minimizes pores and blackheads. It makes it easier to extract blackheads for sure. The product warms up on your face and makes your skin feel clean. Can't wait to buy again

I bought this two days ago and I'm already seeing results, I've been getting really bad break outs recently and wanted to try something new. I've used in 2 days consecutively and woke up this morning with a huge reduction in pore size and it's cleared up a few cystic pimples over night. Did not notice any irritation or drying but I did follow up use with moisture surge from Clinique. Will definitely continue to use.
i only had a sample of it so maybe the applicator is an important part of this product cuz the sample did nothing for my skin, i prefer boscia products for blackhead removal

avis.titre: I do not feel any heating
avis.texte: This product does exfoliate great but I do not feel any self heating. It does seem to make a bit of a difference but does not seem like it will last long for the amount of money. In short, I like it but not sure I would buy it again.

avis.titre: Made my skin feel soft again.
avis.texte: I like the product because It makes my skin feel really soft and the softness last for 2-3 days they I reapply after 3 days to see the difference.

So far, I like this product! It's easy to use and it gets warmer than any other pore warming product I've used.The tip makes me feel like I'm really gettin' in those pores. I've only used a few times but I do feel my pores appear smaller after use.

Blackheads and clogged pores have plagued my skin my whole life, so I've tried everything. I've used acne products that heat-up, scrubs, and exfoliators - but a plastic scrubber tip, no. It seemed a bit weird, but the results aren't - it works! I also have reactive, sensitive skin and this product wasn't irritating or too drying.
I had high hopes based on the reviews, but this is basically an exfoliating scrub. So if you don't exfoliate, you will probably love this, but if you do, don't waste your money.

I've tried numerous products over the years to get rid of the blackheads on my nose and nothing has ever worked. I used this one time and already noticed a huge difference. Highly recommend, just wish it were a little cheaper.
Would give 5 stars if it were cheaper. I did have some skin purging, as in a small breakout after use. Skin is smoother and clearer after healing.

I wanted to love this product, I love everything Clinique from their skincare to their make up... I should buy stock in "Happy" it's been my favorite for years... I have oily skin and large pores and I tend to get blackheads on occasion. This was very rough for my skin, and it made me red for well over an hour. I pressed very gently and followed directions to a T.
This is absolutely the best thing I've ever used for blackhead removal!!!!

avis.titre: Where has this been my whole life
avis.texte: Iv never been so amazed by an acne/blackhead product. I really wish I took a before and after picture on just my first try... that's how drastic of a change it is!! my nose was extremely bumpy due to my HUGE blackheads, it's now soft and smooth. its pricy but worth every penny!!!

avis.titre: Try this before you try a nose strip
avis.texte: I've always had problems with my blackheads; I wear makeup nearly everyday and clean my face everyday as well. There is nothing like this product 😭 My first use removed more than half of my blackheads! Wouldn't recommend anything else 🧡
After using just one time, I can already see AND feel a big difference. This is an amazing product.

I purchased this product about a week ago and have used it twice so far this week along side my regular skin care routine. Its great! There is no irritation which is normally my issue with similar products and I can already see improvement with my pores.

It's super easy to use. Put some of the, what I call, magic cleanser on your trouble area. Wet it until you can feel it heat up and massage it with the top of the cap. It cleanses and makes the black/white heads easier to remove. I've never used anything as useful. It is very pricey but you pay for things that work, and this really works.

I've struggled w large pores due to blackheads my entire life. I was purchasing Clinique acne solutions 3 step kit wen an Ulta employee told me of this new blackhead product from Clinique as well & she swore by it!!! I was convinced to try it & with the first use I was in total amazement!!!! I would say at least 25% of my blackheads were gone. Literally disappeared. I Am now on day 5 of using this product & am even more in love than the first day of use!!!!
I have used this 3 times this week, and I see a huge difference on my nose and chin. My makeup looks better and my skin doesn't flake anymore!
